newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pac in China mobile phone network.
newsitem.headline: First Pac in China mobile phone network.

text.p: First Pacific Co Ltd and its major shareholder, the Salim Group of Indonesia, said on Thursday they were participating in a GSM mobile telephone network and related telecommunications projects in southeastern China's Fujian province.
The firms said in a statement they had a total 34 percent interest in a company whose other shareholders include China's Fujian Enterprises (Holdings) Co Ltd and Fujian Foreign Trade Centre Group.
First Pacific is providing financial, technical and other support to China Unicom Fujian which operates the network under licence from China Unicom, Beijing, the statement said.
The first phase of the project is expected to cost about US$60 million, and to have 50,000 GSM subscribers by the end of 1997.
China Unicom Fujian also plans to provide provincial-wide service by the end of 1998, the statement said.
